what: A 17 mm high cylindrical boss of radius R = 3 mm shares the top of a 12 x 12 x 9 mm plate spanning -9 <= x <= 3 and |y| <= 6. Its only tangent wall is x = R, exactly at the cylinder seam, so the shoulder is one closed edge. The equal-distance 0.75 mm chamfer must run around the complete shoulder and terminate flush with that wall.

expected.method: For 0 <= z <= d = 0.75, the radius is r = R + d - z and one circular cap lies outside the wall x = R. A full cone adds pi*d^2*(R + d/3). A cone clipped on both sides would add F(R+d) - F(R) - pi*R^2*d, where F(r) = (2/3)(2*R*r*q + r^3*asin(R/r) - R^3*ln((r + q)/R)) and q = sqrt(r^2 - R^2). Removing just one of the two equal caps gives the mean of those additions, 5.06835651679739 mm^3. The initial box and post enclose 12*12*9 + 17*pi*R^2.
